breakdown.description: Exit pressure in a choked converging nozzle is higher than ambient (underexpanded)
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the incorrect exit pressure assumption. The generated specification repeats the error from the original prompt by stating, 'The exit pressure is 100 kPa.' In a choked converging nozzle, the exit pressure cannot be lower than the critical pressure (approx. 264 kPa in this case). The ground truth correctly asks to 'Determine the exit pressure,' implying it is not simply the ambient pressure, but the agent ignored this and repeated the user's incorrect value.
